title: Assert exact release version metadata
why: The CI `spec-contract` job now checks that `cargo run -p omnisstream_cli -- version` prints `spec_pin $(cat SPEC_PIN.txt)`. The release workflow also smoke-tests `./target/release/omnisstream version`, but currently only checks that a `spec_pin` line exists.
suggested_scope: Update `.github/workflows/release.yml` in the existing `"smoke: version output"` step.
Keep the existing key-presence checks so release smoke output remains easy to diagnose.
validation: cargo run -p omnisstream_cli -- version | tee version.txt
